aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable source context but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Baseline comparison is invented; source shows a recycle semi-yoke usability test, not explicit normal vs test.
Changed condition mixes recycle semi yoke with blister-size subcategories that appear to be defect dispositions.
Measurement outcomes use header rows and aggregate mixed table values, so statistics are not valid evidence.
Function rows 36-38 are cited but their row text is not shown for verification.
Vision, function, analysis, and reliability results need clearer grouping under one validation report.
correctionPlan: Reframe changed factor as use/reuse of recycled semi yoke after decap unless source proves a baseline.
Treat plating defect categories and size limits as subgroup or inspection outcomes, not primary changed factors.
Re-extract full data rows for vision, function, analysis, reliability, and decision sections.
Remove calculated measurement stats derived from headers or mixed columns.
Cite each outcome to actual data rows and include row-level keys such as date, line, lot, and condition.
